snippet.title: Misguided Remastered Demo OUT NOW – (Steam Next Fest 2026)

Misguided Remastered Demo is out NOW on Steam and Google Play Store!

Uncover Silvia's Past, solve Puzzles, and face your first the Folklore shadows from the Otherworld!

PLAY THE DEMO NOW!
